schema.title: MEX Team identity and Activity preview request v1
schema.description: Caller-authored authority-free request. Every object rejects extra keys; text is trimmed NFC without control characters and runtime byte ceilings apply.

operationId.description: Globally unique within the bounded replay window; never intentionally reuse it.

canonicalText.description: Must already be NFC; maxLength is also enforced as a UTF-8 byte ceiling.

path.description: Canonical contained repository-relative path; 4,096 UTF-8 bytes maximum.

canonicalRepoPath.description: Canonical contained repository-relative path; 4,096 UTF-8 bytes maximum.

applyFile.requirement: Pass the exact complete successful schemaVersion 1 preview JSON emitted for the same command; fragments, altered envelopes, and reconstructed receipts are rejected.
